card.name: The word the before public or universe
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "the" right before a broad-scope noun such as public, community, cosmos or universe. Also fires on a few scattered pieces of names and numbers.

modes.label: The before broad noun

card.writes: It seems to promote odd name pieces and Chinese phrases such as 'in China', while suppressing 'world' words.
card.plain: It fires on "the" before words like universe or public, and it holds back the word "world" there.
